items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

ctx.x: His son is Manuel Sales. He also plays the guitar here. He's telling me. I just thought you might have run across here.
Now that would be so long before all of our time. Because my father died when I was 14 years old. And he played in a brass band. My father did. And he played the, what do you call that? The trumpet?
